Hi Rishi,

I lead research partnerships at OpenHealth Research Institute. We're running a 12-week AI Equity cohort for public hospital teams (cohort starts Jun 1) and I'm reaching out to request a one-off research stipend in the form of Redwood credits to support model experimentation and de-identification tooling for participant data.

Rough ask: 150k token credits (approximate) for three project teams, plus a short extension to the standard trial window so teams can complete final evaluations at the end of the cohort (requested extension: 30 days).

Attached is a short sponsor letter from our Director and a high-level budget estimate. Happy to share more detail if helpful.

Best,

Elena —

Thanks for the note and congrats on launching the cohort. A few quick clarifying questions so we can route to the approvals team:

- Can you confirm the intended usage patterns (short bursts of lab experiments vs sustained batch jobs)? This helps us size the allocation and advise on latency/quantization options.
- Is any patient-identifiable data being processed (we can discuss de-id approaches and if you need Private deployment)?
- Do you already have procurement or contracting timelines (PO / MSA required)?

Looping in Marissa from Customer Programs who handles credit exceptions. If you can share the sponsor letter and budget (you mentioned attached), that will speed review.

I can commit to an initial decision within 3 business days once we have the usage profile and the sponsor letter.

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the extra context and for sending the sponsor letter. Reviewed with the programs team — we can support a credits stipend for cohort labs, with the following guardrails:

- Allocation: provisional 150,000 token-equivalent credits split across up to 3 teams (we'll confirm final buckets after usage profile).
- Trial extension: +30 days for accounts created under this program.
- Need a short MOU (1 page) that articulates permitted use and non-production clause.
- For any data with patient identifiers, we require either a documented de-ID plan or deployment into a Private environment.

Next steps: Ben (copied) will provide a formal allocation note and the MOU template. If you can confirm the usage profile and whether PHI will be in-scope by EOD Tue (May 4), we can finalize and issue credits the week of May 10.

Quick note: please include purchase contact if procurement/PO is needed — otherwise we can process as promotional allocation.

Thanks,
